items.stem: A user asks Microsoft 365 Copilot to summarise a confidential HR file stored in a SharePoint site they cannot open. What happens?

options.text: Copilot summarises it because Copilot has tenant-wide access
options.rationale: Copilot works within the signed-in user's existing permissions; it does not bypass them.

options.text: Copilot cannot use that file because responses are limited to content the user can already access
options.rationale: Correct: the study guide's privacy objective covers how Copilot keeps organisational information private; access follows user permissions.

options.text: Copilot summarises it but removes names
options.rationale: There is no automatic redaction that grants access to unauthorised content.

options.text: Copilot asks the file owner for approval
options.rationale: Copilot has no built-in approval request for this situation.

items.explanation: Correct: the study guide's privacy objective covers how Copilot keeps organisational information private; access follows user permissions.

items.stem: A draft produced by Copilot cites revenue figures for a client report. Which TWO steps are appropriate verification before sending? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Open the cited source documents and check each figure
options.rationale: Correct: citation checks are one of the verification steps named in the skills outline.

options.text: Ask Copilot whether its figures are correct and accept its answer
options.rationale: Self-assessment by the same tool is not independent verification.

options.text: Have a colleague responsible for the account review the numbers
options.rationale: Correct: human review is a named verification practice for consequential content.

options.text: Send it, since grounded responses are always accurate
options.rationale: Grounding reduces but does not eliminate inaccuracies; the outline lists inaccuracy as a risk.

items.explanation: Correct: citation checks are one of the verification steps named in the skills outline.

items.stem: Your team runs the same project-status prompt every Monday. Which feature best fits?

options.rationale: Correct: scheduling a prompt is listed under 'Create and manage prompts'.

options.text: Delete and recreate the chat each week
options.rationale: That loses history and saves no effort.
Renaming helps find a chat but does not run anything.

options.text: Convert it into a Copilot Page
options.rationale: Pages are collaborative content, not a scheduler.
